calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
per AS (SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1, fiscal_year FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 6),
lines AS (
  SELECT c.category, f.net_amount AS net_amt, f.standard_cost AS cost_amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.category, -x.refund_net, -x.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line x
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = x.product_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key
  JOIN per ON x.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, category,
       round(sum(net_amt), 2) AS net_sales,
       round(100 * (1 - sum(cost_amt) / sum(net_amt)), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM lines WHERE category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
